chrome_task.description: Manage durable browser tasks and owned pages. Connections do not own tasks. Default budget: eight created pages; borrowed pages are never cleaned up. Cancellation stops later actions without rolling back dispatched work. finish keepUnknownPages:true requires confirm:true and retains unresolved page-creation receipts, including known tabs and receipts without a tabId, without closing them or claiming cleanup. Default finish stays unverified while those receipts still resolve to pages.

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

keep.description: Owned tab IDs to hand back to the user when finishing.

keepUnknownPages.description: Finish while retaining every unresolved page-creation receipt, including known tabs and receipts without a tabId. Requires confirm: true. Does not close those pages or claim they were cleaned up. Omitted or false leaves finish unverified while such receipts still resolve to pages.

adopt.description: On resume, explicitly accept only the new document identity observed after this task's own navigation-producing action.

confirm.description: Required by takeOver to transfer a durable task from a disconnected or different MCP session. Also required with keepUnknownPages: true on finish.

chrome_skill.description: Find and execute independently verified read-only site skills. Proposals remain candidates until at least two fresh-task tests with different inputs and output assertions pass. Automatic JavaScript steps require a locally reviewed program; new DOM extraction uses args.program="dom-extract" with data-only config. Arbitrary JavaScript and write-capable options are unsupported. Never replay unknown outcomes.

definitionHash.description: Expected active skill definition hash; execution stops if it changed after discovery.

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

definition.description: Executable recipe: id/name/description/domains/keywords/startUrl/inputSchema/outputSchema/steps[{tool,args,resultPath?}]/verification{tool,args,resultPath?}/tests[{inputs,expect,observe}]. Tool identifiers inside recipes always use the chrome_ backend prefix, regardless of displayed MCP tool names. DOM extraction uses the javascript backend with args={program:"dom-extract",config:{fields:[{name,selector,value:"text"|"attribute",attribute?,multiple?}]}}, resultPath="/result". It returns success, fields and sources.page. For multiple sources, verification and observe are matching arrays of 1–8 checks; every independent DOM/GET assertion must pass. URL parameters use {{key}}. Do not persist credentials, tab identities or refs.

get_windows_and_tabs.description: Get all currently open browser windows and tabs

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_navigate.description: Navigate to a URL, refresh the current tab, or navigate browser history (back/forward)

url.description: URL to navigate to. Special values: "back" or "forward" to navigate browser history in the target tab.

action.description: Alternative to url="back"|"forward": navigate browser history backward or forward.

newWindow.description: Create a new window to navigate to the URL or not. Defaults to false

newTab.description: Create a new tab even when a matching page is already open. Defaults to false

tabId.description: Target an existing tab by ID (if provided, navigate/refresh/back/forward that tab instead of the active tab).

windowId.description: Target an existing window by ID (when creating a new tab in existing window, or picking active tab if tabId is not provided).

background.description: Perform the operation without stealing focus (do not activate the tab or focus the window). Default: true (set false only if user explicitly asks to bring tab to foreground)

width.description: Window width in pixels (default: 1280). When width or height is provided, a new window will be created.

height.description: Window height in pixels (default: 720). When width or height is provided, a new window will be created.

refresh.description: Refresh the current active tab instead of navigating to a URL. When true, the url parameter is ignored. Defaults to false

groupTitle.description: Concise, task-aligned title for the Chrome tab group reflecting user intent in user language (e.g. "Best 4K Monitors on Amazon", "GitHub PR Review"). If omitted, the extension derives a smart title dynamically from the destination domain and page title instead of generic fallback.

groupColor.description: Color for the Chrome tab group. Fallback: "blue"

autoGroup.description: Automatically place newly opened tab into an Agent-managed tab group with dedicated title and color. Default: true

dismissOverlays.description: Automatically detect and dismiss visible marketing popups, coupon modals, and promotional overlays after navigation completes (default: false)

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_screenshot.description: [Prefer browserpaw_read_dom over taking a screenshot] Capture the page, a region, or an element as PNG/JPEG. The default inline JPEG is fitted to a 1568px long edge and 1.15MP for a practical OCR/token balance. Tune sharpness with maxWidth, maxDimension, maxPixels, highClarity, or region. savePng writes the full-resolution physical-pixel PNG for user-facing delivery.

name.description: Name or label for the screenshot. Purely in-memory by default; only written to disk if savePng/saveToDisk is explicitly set to true.

selector.description: CSS selector for element to screenshot

assetIndex.description: View one visual asset listed by browserpaw_read_dom ([asset N] lines): returns the real image resource; falls back to a viewport crop when bytes are unavailable

tabId.description: Target tab ID to capture from (default: active tab).

windowId.description: Target window ID to pick active tab from when tabId is not provided.

background.description: Attempt capture without bringing tab/window to foreground. CDP-based capture is used for viewport captures. Default: true

maxWidth.description: Optional hard cap on image width in pixels, applied together with the vision budget.

maxDimension.description: Maximum long edge in pixels for the model-facing image (default: 1568). Lower it to reduce tokens; raise it for fine text.

maxPixels.description: Maximum total pixels for the model-facing image (default: 1,150,000). Lower it to reduce tokens; raise it for dense pages.

storeBase64.description: Return screenshot in base64 format in text content (image content is always returned directly)

fullPage.description: Capture a full-page scroll screenshot with GoFullPage-grade industrial stitching: automatic StyleStack fixed/sticky header de-duplication, page warmup for lazy-loading/skeletons, dynamic height change recovery, and captureVisibleTab quota backoff retry (default: false).

maxHeight.description: Maximum height in pixels to capture for full-page screenshots (default: 50000, protects against infinite scroll runaway).

savePng.description: Save a full-resolution, lossless PNG at the capture physical-pixel size to the system temporary directory. Use this for screenshots the user asked to view or keep.

saveToDisk.description: Deprecated alias for savePng (default: false, zero disk write by default; saves to system temp, not Downloads). Prefer savePng.

som.description: Overlay Set-of-Mark numbered badges on interactive elements before capturing the screenshot

highlight.description: Deprecated alias for som; still accepted but hidden from the schema to keep it small. Prefer som.

targetIndex.description: Compact 1-based numeric index of target element from browserpaw_read_dom to crop and capture only this specific region of interest

index.description: Alias for targetIndex: compact 1-based numeric index of target element from browserpaw_read_dom to crop and capture

padding.description: Padding in pixels to expand around targetIndex crop area (default: 0)

region.description: High-density ROI crop: capture only a specific sub-region { x0, y0, x1, y1 } in CSS pixels or polymorphic [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]. Use it to inspect fine text without paying for the full page.

crop.description: Alias for region: { x, y, width, height } or { x0, y0, x1, y1 }.

grid.description: Overlay semi-transparent coordinate reference grid with perimeter tape measure rulers (20/50/100px ticks) and interior reticle crosshairs (+) to eliminate visual estimation hallucination (default: false)

enableGrid.description: Alias for grid: overlay semi-transparent coordinate reference grid with perimeter tape measure rulers and crosshairs

expandSearchArea.description: For small elements (< 100x100), adaptively expand the crop bounding box to preserve surrounding headers and text context (default: true)

format.description: Output format: jpeg (default, compact for model inspection) or png (lossless). Saved screenshots are always PNG.

highClarity.description: Disable the default vision budget and keep the native CSS-pixel image, unless maxDimension/maxPixels/maxWidth is explicitly set.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_close_tabs.description: Close one or more browser tabs

tabId.description: Single tab ID to close (convenience alternative to tabIds array).

tabIds.description: Array of tab IDs to close. If not provided, will close the active tab (requires confirm: true or session affinity).

expectedTabs.description: Fail-closed tab identities for task-owned cleanup. All tab IDs must match the current document and browser before any tab is closed.

url.description: Close tabs matching this URL. Can be used instead of tabIds.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation required to close the active tab when tabIds or url are not specified.

allManagedGroups.description: Close all Agent-managed tab groups and their tabs created during automation sessions. Default: false

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_switch_tab.description: Switch to a specific browser tab

tabId.description: The ID of the tab to switch to.

windowId.description: The ID of the window where the tab is located.

background.description: If true, binds session affinity only without activating the tab in the Chrome UI or stealing user focus. Default: false

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_read_dom.description: Extract and prune interactive DOM tree with compact 1-based index assignment, viewport boundary filtering, and occlusion pruning. Supports scoped container targeting (selector) and noise exclusion (exclude) to eliminate full DOM dump overhead. Optional dismissOverlays closes modals and removes overlay elements.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope parsing to a specific container/element (e.g. "#main-cart", ".dialog-box"). Only descendants and self within matching containers are indexed.

scope.description: Alias for selector. CSS selector to scope parsing to a specific container/element (e.g. "#main-cart", ".dialog-box"). Only descendants and self within matching containers are indexed.

isolateModal.description: When true and an active modal dialog is detected, restricts indexing to the active interaction surface. Standalone modal/portal roots are included through standard dialog/top-layer/popover semantics and explicit ARIA ownership relationships, not a fixed framework class list. Set false to observe background content while still reporting the active modal.

exclude.description: CSS selector(s) to exclude from parsing (e.g. "#footer, #recommendations, .ad-banner"). Matching elements and their entire subtrees are pruned.

viewportThreshold.description: Vertical threshold in pixels for viewport boundary checking (default 1000)

highlight.description: Whether to visually highlight indexed elements

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

cursor.description: Pagination cursor offset for traversing very large DOM pages incrementally (default: 0)

limit.description: Maximum number of indexed elements to return for current page cursor slice (default: unlimited)

maxTextLength.description: Maximum text length before truncation for element text content (default: 120)

includeDetails.description: Also return detailed element geometry and flags, or structured actions and validation metadata in fast mode. Off by default; the tree already carries actionable refs, labels, and values.

viewportOnly.description: When true, only index elements inside or immediately near the visible viewport (default: false)

activeViewportOnly.description: When true, strictly constrains indexing to elements currently visible within the active viewport (threshold = 0) with horizontal/vertical frustum clipping, eliminating ghost elements from SPA wizards, carousels, and multi-step forms.

format.description: Output format for treeString. "compact" (default) uses a concise accessibility-inspired tree without closing tags. "html" returns pseudo-HTML tags. "fast" returns a budgeted snapshot; latency and total bytes depend on the page and frames.

fast.description: When true, uses the fast snapshot engine with stable document refs, native visibility checks, and a shared limit of 250 actions and 6000 body characters across reported frames. Truncation and unverified frame coverage are explicit. flattenCards and virtualizeViewport are rejected before observation because fast does not implement them; isolateModal true/false is supported.

legacyVisibility.description: When true, uses legacy visibility fallback (computedStyle display/visibility/opacity) instead of element.checkVisibility.

deltaOnly.description: When true, returns changes compared to the previous compatible snapshot. A missing or incompatible baseline returns a full snapshot; fast mode uses the standard representation for delta requests.

dismissOverlays.description: When true, automatically detects and dismisses visible marketing popups, coupon modals, and promotional overlays before indexing DOM nodes, preventing modal overlays from polluting the DOM tree (default: false)

virtualizeViewport.description: When true (enabled by default on infinite scroll, long feeds, and waterfall pages when selector/scope is omitted), intelligently virtualizes and folds repetitive offscreen subtrees into compact summaries, drastically slashing token usage while strictly preserving visible viewport elements and key navigation.

flattenCards.description: When true (default: true), identifies composite card containers (article, [role="article"], [role="listitem"], li) and aggregates fragmented leaf nodes into structured card summaries while preserving actionable link/click indices.

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_interact_index.description: Click, hover, or interact with an element using its compact 1-based numeric index from browserpaw_read_dom. When performing predictable multi-step actions (e.g. form submission or chain navigation), prefer browserpaw_batch_actions to finish in a single round-trip.

index.description: Compact 1-based numeric index of the target element

frameId.description: Resolve only in this frame, including explicit main frame 0; never cross-frame fallback.

oneOf.description: Point [x, y] or bounding box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

coordinate.description: Visual fallback coordinates in viewport/CSS pixels: { x, y } object, [x, y] point, or [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] bounding box (supports 0~1.0 normalized, 0~1000 per-mille, or absolute viewport pixels across modern vision agents).

coordinateSpace.description: Coordinate reference space. "viewport" (default) assumes standard CSS viewport pixels. "screenshot" scales coordinates through the capture named by captureId and requires that identity.

captureId.description: Screenshot identity returned by browserpaw_screenshot. Required when coordinateSpace is "screenshot"; dispatch fails if the document, DOM revision, viewport, DPR, scroll position, or capture identity is stale or superseded.

autoSnap.description: When clicking via coordinates or visual fallback, magnetically snap to the closest interactive element if clicked within 24px of whitespace. Default: true.

points.description: Click sequence: dispatch a full CDP click at each point with intervalMs pacing. When captureId is provided, the capture is revalidated before every point; the sequence stops after the first DOM/geometry drift instead of replaying.

intervalMs.description: Delay between points in the click sequence, 5-500ms (default 35)

action.description: Interaction action to perform (default: click). "drag" requires `end` and moves from the indexed element to that target.

path.description: Continuous drag path: an ordered array of { x, y } coordinates to smoothly drag the mouse through while pressed. Ideal for circular gestures, sliders, and drawing on canvas.

index.description: 1-based index (from browserpaw_read_dom) of the drag destination element

coordinate.description: Drag destination as viewport coordinates when no index is available

end.description: Drag destination: { index } for an indexed element, or { coordinate: { x, y } } for a raw point. Required when action is "drag".

steps.description: Number of intermediate mouse-move steps for drag (default 48; lower is faster, higher is smoother)

holdMs.description: How long to hold the mouse button before dragging, in ms (default 80, range 0-3000)

dnd.description: Use HTML5 drag-and-drop events (dragstart/dragover/drop) instead of raw mouse moves. Needed for React/HTML5 DnD lists.

modifiers.description: Keyboard modifiers to hold during interaction

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle (quiet for 150ms or timeout) after interaction before returning (default: false)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds (default: 1500, range: 200-10000)

humanize.description: Simulate realistic human-like cursor trajectory with micro-jitter before clicking (default: false)

includeDelta.description: Automatically capture and return lightweight chained snapshot (activeElement, modal status, key DOM changes) in chainedSnapshot (default: true; set false to disable)

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

pierceOverlay.description: Automatically pierce non-opaque or transient backdrop masks/loading stubs when intercepted (default: true)

waitForNetworkQuiescence.description: Wait for in-flight network requests to settle after this interaction before returning (default: false)

urlPattern.description: URL pattern or substring to match (e.g. "*/api/order*", "/checkout")

method.description: Optional HTTP method to filter by (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the matching network response (default: 5000ms)

statusCodes.description: Optional HTTP status codes to accept (e.g. [200, 201])

captureNetwork.description: Inline capture of network response triggered by this interaction in a single round-trip

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_fill_index.description: Fill text into an input, textarea, or editable element using its index or a strict locator. Filling verifies the field value only. A caller-requested Enter is an explicit separate action; `submit: true` requires `submitTarget` and uses the normal trusted click path.

index.description: Compact 1-based numeric index of the target element

frameId.description: Resolve only in this frame, including explicit main frame 0; never cross-frame fallback.

text.description: Text content to fill into the element

clear.description: Whether to clear existing field content before typing (default: true)

pressEnter.description: Dispatch one explicit Enter after the field value is verified (default: false). This is a key action, not proof that a form or external write succeeded. Do not combine with submit:true.

submit.description: Click the caller-specified submitTarget after filling. Requires submitTarget; missing or ambiguous targets reject the request before dispatch. Do not combine with pressEnter:true.

index.description: Element index from the current observation

frameId.description: Resolve only in this frame; never fall back to another frame.

ref.description: Element ref or numeric index from the current observation

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for the target

label.description: Associated native or ARIA label target

exact.description: Require an exact text or label match

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle after filling text before returning (default: false)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds (default: 1500, range: 200-10000)

includeDelta.description: Automatically capture and return lightweight chained snapshot (activeElement, modal status, key DOM changes) in chainedSnapshot (default: true; set false to disable)

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_batch_actions.description:
Execute a sequential multi-step pipeline of browser actions in a single round-trip without waiting for intermediate model turns.
* List each mutation explicitly. A fill step does not implicitly advance or submit a form; list the click or press_key step when the task authorizes it.
* Supported action types: click, double_click, right_click, fill, hover, scroll, press_key, wait, fill_form, assert, extract.
* Set includeDelta: true to automatically inspect DOM changes after the pipeline completes.

frameId.description: Resolve only in this frame; never fall back to a different frame.

ref.description: Target element numeric index or ref from browserpaw_read_dom

selector.description: CSS selector or XPath for target element

targetText.description: Target element by visible text when text is a fill value.

role.description: Strict target by supported implicit or explicit ARIA role.

label.description: Strict target by associated native or ARIA label.

exact.description: Require an exact text, accessible name, or label match.

pressEnter.description: Whether to dispatch an Enter key event immediately after filling the text (for type: fill)

submit.description: Click the explicit submitTarget after filling (for type: fill). Requires submitTarget and cannot be combined with pressEnter.

index.description: Element index from the current observation

exact.description: Require an exact text or label match

fields.description: Array of field descriptors to fill sequentially (for fill_form)

oneOf.description: Point [x, y] or bounding box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

coordinate.description: Unified coordinate object or array for click or scroll

at.description: Absolute epoch-ms deadline: sleep until this instant before executing this action (extension-side timer, no extra round-trip)

direction.description: Scroll direction (left/right dispatch horizontal wheel deltas)

note.description: Optional intent note displayed on virtual agent cursor during execution

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM mutations to settle after this specific action (default: false)

pierceOverlay.description: Automatically pierce non-opaque or transient backdrop masks for click actions (default: true)

preferComposer.description: Prioritize rich composer/editor elements over generic search inputs when resolving textbox (default: false)

expectedText.description: Expected text substring or exact match

condition.description: Assertion condition: contains, not_contains, equals, matches (regex), visible, not_visible, enabled, disabled, valid, invalid, checked, unchecked (default: "contains")

timeoutMs.description: Async polling timeout in milliseconds for assertion settling (default: 300ms)

abortOnFailure.description: Abort batch if assertion fails (default: true)

variableName.description: Key name under extractedData to store the result

method.description: Optional HTTP method to filter by (GET, POST, etc.)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the network response (default: 5000ms)

statusCodes.description: Optional HTTP status codes to accept

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle timeout in milliseconds (default: 1500, range: 200-10000)

waitForNetworkQuiescence.description: Wait for in-flight network requests to settle after all actions before returning (default: false)

includeDelta.description: Automatically capture and return DOM changes caused by the batch in the delta field (default: false)

chrome_get_markdown.description: Extract clean, structured hierarchical markdown from the active tab DOM stripped of SPA state blobs, hidden text, and scripts.

chrome_smart_scroll.description: Intelligently detects and scrolls the most prominent scrollable container on the page, or targets a specific container by selector, ref, or coordinate with automatic progress calculation.

amount.description: Scroll amount: number in pixels, "page" (viewport height), or "half_page" (default: "page")

selector.description: Optional CSS selector of the scroll container to target

ref.description: Optional 1-based numeric index of the scroll container to target

index.description: Alias for ref: 1-based numeric index of the scroll container to target

oneOf.description: Point [x, y] or bounding box [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]

coordinate.description: Optional coordinate to locate the scrollable container under pointer: { x, y } object, [x, y] point, or [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] bounding box

smooth.description: Whether to use smooth scrolling behavior (default: true)

waitForSettle.description: Wait for DOM and network activity to settle after scroll completes (default: true)

settleTimeoutMs.description: Maximum settle wait timeout in ms (default: 1500)

note.description: Optional intent note displayed on virtual agent cursor during scrolling (e.g. "Scrolling down timeline")

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_tool_docs.description: Return compact parameter documentation for a category of BrowserPaw tools (navigate | perceive | act | observe | manage | crawl | diagnose | network). Use when a workflow needs a tool that is not in the current profile view.

activateForSession.description: When true, dynamically exposes all tools in this category for the current MCP session without server restart. Default: false

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_inspect_media.description: Inspect and extract high-fidelity media assets (images, canvas, captchas, icons) directly by element index or selector. Uses in-memory lossless extraction for ``/``, with super-sampled 200%+ crop fallback for complex DOM containers.

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_grep.description: Search the page without dumping full DOM tree. Supports searching interactive elements (returning indices for browserpaw_interact_index), all DOM nodes, or raw visible text lines.

isRegex.description: Whether to evaluate query as a regular expression (default: false)

searchType.description: Search target: "interactive_only" (default, matches clickable/fillable elements and returns indices), "all_dom" (matches all elements), "page_text" (scans visible text lines).

limit.description: Maximum matching results to return (default: 20, max: 50)

autoScroll.description: When true, automatically executes client-side RAF auto-scrolling to probe and detect off-screen virtualized elements (virtual list / infinite scroll streams like X/Twitter). Default: false

maxSteps.description: Maximum scroll iterations to attempt when autoScroll is enabled (default: 10)

stepPx.description: Pixel distance to scroll on each probing step (default: 800)

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_act_toward_goal.description: Run a bounded semantic micro-loop toward a natural-language page goal. The loop perceives the current page, chooses an action, verifies the result, and escalates ambiguous, destructive, or low-confidence decisions back to the calling agent.

goal.description: Natural language goal or objective to advance toward on the current page

tabId.description: Target tab ID (optional, defaults to active tab)

maxSteps.description: Maximum decision steps before terminating (default: 10, max: 60)

timeoutMs.description: Total execution timeout in milliseconds (default: 90000, max: 300000)

textHint.description: Explicit text hint to enter when typing, if not clearly quoted in goal

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum confidence threshold to commit an action (minimum/default: 0.85)

pauseBeforeKeywords.description: List of keywords (e.g. ["Post", "Submit", "Pay"]). If the predicted action targets an element whose label, text, or role matches any keyword, the micro-loop suspends before execution and returns status "paused" with target element context for System 2 confirmation.

sessionId.description: Optional session identifier to bind affinity to a specific tab context

pressEnter.description: Explicitly authorizes one Enter key step when the selected action is a fill. It does not prove business submission; generic forms and external writes still require caller authorization.

mode.description: Requested Jev mode. Must match the globally enabled backend; cannot override off or switch backends.

verification.description: Read-only independent observations required to declare the goal complete. Without these, completion remains unverified.

expect.description: Concrete JSON Schema assertion over the observed result.

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_insert_media.description: Injects an image or media asset from local disk, URL, or base64 into a rich-text composer (e.g. Reddit, Twitter/X, Notion, Discord, Slack, GitHub) or targeted element via synthesized ClipboardEvent("paste") and DragEvent("drop") containing a real File object in DataTransfer, bypassing browser clipboard security sandboxes.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the image or media file on local disk (e.g. "C:\Users\...\diagram.png" or "/home/.../photo.jpg")

fileUrl.description: Remote HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch the image or media asset from

base64Data.description: Base64-encoded media data string, optionally with "data:<mime>;base64," prefix

fileName.description: Optional filename to associate with the injected file (e.g. "architecture.png")

mimeType.description: MIME type of the media (e.g. "image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/gif", "image/webp", "image/svg+xml"). Auto-detected if omitted.

index.description: 1-based compact element index from browserpaw_read_dom targeting the rich-text editor or composer. Defaults to active element or discovered composer.

selector.description: CSS selector for the target container (optional fallback for index)

tabId.description: Target tab ID (optional, defaults to active tab)

sessionId.description: Session identifier for tab affinity binding

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.

chrome_scroll_until_found.description: Performs automated client-side RAF auto-scrolling and live DOM / Shadow-DOM detection to locate target text, regex, or selector without multi-turn LLM polling loops. Designed specifically for infinite scroll and virtualized feeds (e.g. X/Twitter, Reddit, Weibo). Immediately stops when target appears, centers element in viewport, and returns its 1-based interactive index.

query.description: Text string or regex pattern to search for during scrolling.

isRegex.description: Whether to evaluate query as a regular expression (default: false).

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element (supports Shadow DOM piercing combinators like >>>).

role.description: ARIA role to filter matching elements (e.g. "button", "article", "link").

stepPx.description: Pixel offset to scroll on each step (default: 800).

maxSteps.description: Maximum scroll iterations before stopping (default: 10, max: 30).

scrollDelayMs.description: Pause duration in ms after each step to allow virtual list rendering (default: 250ms). Alias for settleMs.

settleMs.description: Pause duration in ms after each step to allow virtual list rendering (default: 150ms).

timeoutMs.description: Total maximum time in milliseconds to scroll before stopping (default: 15000, max: 60000).

containerSelector.description: Optional CSS selector of specific scrollable container instead of window/document.

actionOnFound.description: Action to perform automatically when element is found (default: "scroll_into_view").

taskId.description: Optional durable task identity; restricts this operation to its verified pages.
